title: Path
description: A Chimera Path authoring contract produced by instructional-design-toolkit. A PATH is a SUPER-STRUCTURE *above* the cmi5-course layer (course.schema.json): it references existing courses by id or slug, groups them into ordered MILESTONES, and wraps them in a credential. The per-course cmi5/xAPI contract is UNTOUCHED — a path adds NO AU and NO block; it is purely additive. xAPI identity (additive, no collision with course IRIs): the path activity IRI is `path:<slug>`, each milestone activity IRI is `path:<slug>/milestone:<ordinal>`. The credential is an OpenBadge 3.0 achievement (credential.cert_name / skills_demonstrated / earning_criteria seed the OpenBadge template — NOT a new cmi5 AU). IDs (meta.id, milestones[].id) are IMMUTABLE once created — changing them breaks xAPI history and OpenBadge issuance for learners. Slugs and titles are mutable. Field names align with the chimera-academy content source-of-truth at schemas/path.schema.yml (content/paths/<slug>/path-overview.md frontmatter); this JSON schema is the toolkit authoring contract and additionally carries the meta.id / version cmi5-identity fields the YAML omits.

id.description: IMMUTABLE path identifier. Doubles as the path-level xAPI activity IRI (path:<slug>). Changing it breaks xAPI history and OpenBadge issuance.

version.description: Semantic version. MAJOR=breaking (milestone removed/reordered, course removed from a milestone, credential criteria hardened), MINOR=additive (course or milestone added), PATCH=cosmetic (title/description/presentation tweaks).

slug.description: URL + xAPI IRI key. Must be stable once published. Mirrors chimera-academy path.slug.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Mirrors chimera-academy path.status (default draft).

level.description: Aggregate difficulty of the path (independent of Chimera Score rank).

emblem.description: Emoji/glyph for the credential badge when no image URL is set.

credential.description: OpenBadge 3.0 achievement metadata. This is NOT a new cmi5 AU — it is the path-level credential definition that seeds the OpenBadge template (and chimera-academy paths.{cert_name,skills_demonstrated,earning_criteria} columns).

cert_name.description: Path certificate / credential name (e.g. 'Agentic AI Engineer').

skills_demonstrated.description: Curated path-level skills (distinct from per-course tags). Maps to OpenBadge 3.0 achievement skills.

earning_criteria.description: How a learner earns the credential (bullet list). Maps to OpenBadge 3.0 achievement criteria.

presentation.description: Path-card and credential presentation metadata (no pedagogical weight).

tech_pills.description: 3-4 most-recognisable technologies the path teaches (path card).

reward_points.description: Chimera Score reward on completion (reconciled with score-engine).

credential_badge_url.description: Optional optimized badge image; overrides emblem when set.

milestones.description: Ordered named phases. Each groups ordered course references. A milestone adds NO cmi5 AU — its xAPI identity is path:<slug>/milestone:<ordinal>.

id.description: IMMUTABLE milestone identifier. Either a bare `milestone:<slug>` or the fully-qualified `path:<slug>/milestone:<n>` form (the latter is the xAPI activity IRI). Changing it breaks xAPI history.

ordinal.description: 1-based position of this milestone within the path (teaching order).

courses.description: Member courses in teaching order. Each entry is either a cmi5 course id (`course:<slug>`) or a bare course slug. The path REFERENCES these courses — it never modifies their course.json.
